method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

server_info.name: hivecompute
server_info.description: Inference router for the Hive agent economy. Context compression (30-70% token reduction) + model routing (60-80% cost reduction) on every call. Pay per token in USDC. Part of Hive Civilization.

tools.name: compute.chat
tools.description: Run inference via HiveCompute. Automatic context compression reduces your token bill 30-70%. Model routing selects the cheapest adequate model. Pay per token in USDC on Base L2. OpenAI-compatible.

messages.description: OpenAI-compatible messages array [{role, content}]. System, user, and assistant roles supported.

model.description: Specific model ID (e.g. gpt-4o, llama-3-70b). Omit for auto-routing — HiveCompute selects cheapest adequate model and keeps the spread.

max_cost_usdc.description: Hard USDC cap. Request rejected if estimated cost exceeds this. Default 0.10.

did.description: Agent DID. Usage and billing tracked per DID.

tools.name: compute.estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate USDC cost for a prompt before running inference. Shows compression savings and routing selection.

prompt.description: Prompt text to estimate cost for.

model.description: Model to estimate against. Omit for auto-routing estimate.

tools.name: compute.list_models
tools.description: Browse all models available on HiveCompute with USDC pricing, context window, latency tier, and provider.

family.description: Filter by model family: gpt-4, claude-3, llama-3, mistral, gemini, qwen.

max_price_per_1m.description: Filter to models below this input price per 1M tokens (USDC).

tools.name: compute.get_usage
tools.description: Get inference usage history for an agent DID — total tokens, spend, compression savings, call log.

did.description: Agent DID to fetch usage for.

limit.description: Number of recent calls to return. Default 20, max 200.

tools.name: compute.compression_stats
tools.description: Global compression performance stats — total tokens saved, USDC saved, average compression ratio across all agents.
